title: Corvi directional mail-resource parent reference contract (design only)
description: Checks optional MailProvider.gatewayRef and required Mailbox.providerRef and MailIdentity.mailboxRef reference shapes. A provider without gatewayRef is a valid management-only provider, never automatically attached. These are design contracts, NOT structural Kubernetes CRD manifests; see ADR-0013.

metadata.description: The actual Kubernetes metadata object includes Kubernetes-defined fields; this design schema asserts only name and namespace.

mailProviderSpec.description: Optional, singular, same-namespace gatewayRef. Absence means provider management only, no gateway mail access. Other provider settings are specified by future full CRD schema.

mailboxSpec.description: Reference contract ONLY; full spec fields and policy validation are defined in separate CRD designs.

mailIdentitySpec.description: Reference contract ONLY; full spec fields and policy validation are defined in separate CRD designs.

x-corvi-ref-chain.namespace: Any specified reference MUST point to a parent in the same namespace; missing required parents or an invalid specified gateway fail closed. Omitted gatewayRef is valid, not an error.
x-corvi-ref-chain.cardinality: MailProvider has zero or one gateway; Mailbox exactly one provider; MailIdentity exactly one mailbox. Each parent can have many children. A MailProvider CRD cannot be shared by multiple independent CorviGateways.
x-corvi-ref-chain.graph: Gateway has no inverse provider/mailbox/identity lists. Unbound providers are excluded from every gateway's effective mail-identity view.
x-corvi-ref-chain.security: Attaching/rebinding a provider requires scoped activation and rechecks of OAuth grants/audience. Detach revokes gateway access before any other action; never auto-reuse old consent. Do not cascade-delete upstream mail or secrets.
x-corvi-ref-chain.publication: Atomic versioned gateway snapshots; gateway Pods do not query Kubernetes API.
x-corvi-ref-chain.configuration: Standalone and Helm-direct configurations use the same logical optional gateway association without requiring CRDs.
x-corvi-ref-chain.crdStatus: Statuses are separate Kubernetes subresources; no secrets or raw message data in status.
